subject: Embed/rerank transition: gap closure & backfill responsibilities
messages:
From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@terranova.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@terranova.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial embed/rerank cutover discussion

Hi Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We reviewed the export and our data team flagged a couple of immediate concerns:

- One-off documents with long HTML payloads that broke embeddings in the test seed (attached a sample row).
- The current index schema in our VectorDB (WeaveStore) has two namespaces: `prod` and `legacy`. Prod contains ~1.2M vectors; legacy is ~180k.

We want to avoid a full reindex if possible. Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can do a targeted backfill for the 180k legacy rows, and 2) what the expected downtime/latency impact is during the backfill?

For context, we have a commercial launch milestone on 2027-04-15 and need the rerank quality gate to pass by 2027-04-05.

Attached: terranova-index-diff.csv (sample diffs)

Alex
VP, Search Engineering
TerraNova AI
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@terranova.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@terranova.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_coole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed/rerank transition: gap closure & backfill responsibilities

Alex — thanks for the details and the sample. Short answers up front: yes, we can do a targeted backfill of the ~180k legacy vectors and we can keep prod queries routing to the existing prod namespace during the operation (no downtime if we run it with the recommended staging swap).

Plan (high level):
1) Prepare a staging namespace and run a small pilot on 10k legacy documents to validate tokenization/embedding parity.
2) Execute batched backfill (preferred: incremental windows of 25k) into staging while continuing to accept prod reads.
3) Run the rerank eval suite against staging and compare P@1 / MRR against prod.
4) If pass, perform a switch-over using a read-redirect for 30 minutes and monitor error/latency metrics.

Risks/notes:
- The HTML-cleaning edge cases you showed will need a preprocessing step; we can include a lightweight HTML sanitizer before embedding which may change vector values slightly — we should re-run rerank evals after sanitization.
- We recommend quantized float16 for the backfill to speed throughput; we can re-quantize later.

I’ll schedule a short working session Monday to align on the pilot dataset and ownership. I attached a Mutual Action Plan skeleton for roles & timing.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx

— Logan
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@terranova.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@terranova.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_coole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed/rerank transition: gap closure & backfill responsibilities

Morning — adding implementation details from the infra side. Technical asks and defaults we propose: 

- Vector store: WeaveStore (TerraNova) — we'll create `staging_v2` namespace and use copy-on-write for vectors.
- Batch size: 25k vectors per job, concurrency=4. Expected throughput: ~8k vectors/min with our recommended GPU-accelerated encoder (Triton endpoints).
- Sanitizer: run a DOM-strip pass + max-text-snippet=8k chars. Anything above will be truncated and checksum-logged.
- Rerank evals: use the attached sample (rerank-eval-sample.jsonl). We'll compute delta MRR and P@1; acceptance threshold = no worse than -0.02 MRR, and top-1 uplift >= +0.01 for target queries.

Operational plan (timeline, tentative):
- 2027-03-23: Pilot 10k backfill on staging_v2 (owner: TerraNova eng, observer: Redwood infra)
- 2027-03-24 to 2027-03-29: Incremental backfill windows (25k each)
- 2027-03-30: Full rerank eval and QA pass
- 2027-04-01: Canary swap (2 hour window)
- 2027-04-05: Quality gate close

I'll bring a runbook to the pilot call. Flagging two decisions we need from TerraNova by EOD Tue:
A) Approval to run sanitizer that truncates >8k chars
B) Confirmation that WeaveStore supports copy-on-write snapshots for read-redirects (or we provide an agent to proxy reads)

- Priyom
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rerank-eval-sample.jsonl]
From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@terranova.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_coole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@terranova.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed/rerank transition: gap closure & backfill responsibilities

Thanks Priyom — that looks reasonable. A couple quick answers:

A) Approved: run sanitizer with truncation at 8k chars. Please checksum and keep logs for any truncated rows.
B) WeaveStore: we do not have native copy-on-write snapshots today. We can allow read-proxying, or you can write into a separate namespace and we will switch an edge flag. We'll coordinate with our platform team.

Action items I own:
- I will confirm with platform by EOD today if the team can accept a DNS/edge flag swap for the canary window.
- Send the pilot token/sample (we'll provide a scoped API key)

Also attaching the index diff CSV — I pulled a few more rows and highlighted obvious HTML-heavy items.

Alex
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@terranova.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@terranova.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_coole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed/rerank transition: gap closure & backfill responsibilities

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Alex. Next steps before the pilot call (scheduled 2027-03-23 10:00 PT):

- TerraNova: share scoped API key for a pilot dataset (10k) and confirm platform team contact for edge swap.
- Redwood: Priyom will provision the pilot runner + sanitizer and share the runbook and expected metrics dashboard link.
- Marissa: I'll hand this over to Customer Success ops for weekly check-ins post-pilot. Marissa, can you take lead on the weekly cadence and stakeholder updates?

Marissa — any additional onboarding artifacts you want me to include in the follow-up invite?

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

— Logan
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
